subject: CLAIM api-surface-sonnet: newBufferWithBytesNoCopy (reference semantics: caller pointer, copy-in per command, blit write-back)
body:
newBufferWithBytesNoCopy:length:options:deallocator: is a refused selector today (nil + TEGU_SELECTOR_REFUSED). The kernel cannot import user pages, so I implement the reference plugin's scheme (ansuz CA-METAL 10.4): -contents returns the CALLER's pointer; the BO is a GPU-side copy refreshed from the caller's memory before each command that binds the buffer; blit destinations are written back to the caller's memory (exact written range only, so an app writing other slots concurrently is not clobbered) after completion; the deallocator runs when the buffer dies. Compute writes into such buffers are NOT copied back (documented limit, same as the reference). Page-aligned pointer required, shared storage only.
Exact regions: compute_frontend.m: TeguBuffer ivar block: ONE line 'unsigned char *external;NSUInteger externalLength;void *externalDeallocator;unsigned externalEpoch;'; -[TeguBuffer contents] one line (external pointer first); TeguBuffer -dealloc: one call tegu_buffer_external_free(self); TeguComputeDevice -newBufferWithBytesNoCopy: stub body -> call tegu_device_new_nocopy(); teguExecute: ONE line after my existing tegu_command_indirect_verify line ('if(!error)tegu_nocopy_sync_in(self);' skipped by a global live counter when no such buffer exists); teguFinishGPU: ONE line after the reap ('tegu_nocopy_sync_out(self);' likewise). Everything else in api_surface.inc. encode-cpu-opus: both hooks are single guarded calls with no timing impact when no no-copy buffer is alive.
